node_modules/.pnpm/mermaid@10.9.8/node_m.rationale: The pinned Mermaid 10.9.8 security-backport package registers this legacy graph renderer as a demand-only catalog entry, producing a measured 508,673 B raw / 151,723 B gzip closure. Local prevalidation accepts the modern flowchart header only and rejects the legacy graph header before Mermaid is loaded, so this artifact has no supported request path; the narrow package-entry ceiling prevents silent growth without importing private hashed internals.

The official Mermaid root API exposes an all-diagram demand-loaded catalog, including a measured 1,874,316 B raw / 564,108 B gzip ELK renderer closure. This tool fixes renderer configuration, rejects frontmatter and init directives, and accepts only the plain flowchart header, so flowchart-elk cannot be selected; this exact pinned-package exception records unavoidable static artifact cost while keeping the global 500 kB gate intact.

The official Mermaid root API also emits an unsupported mindmap catalog entry with a measured 882,467 B raw / 265,935 B gzip closure. The source allow-list rejects mindmap before loading Mermaid, and the application neither imports nor reaches this entry; this exact 10.9.8 package ceiling makes the otherwise unavoidable demand-only artifact explicit without weakening default route budgets.
